COUNTY BOUNDARY
PENNSYLVANIA
Erie County
Population266,000 (2025 est.)
County SeatErie
Land Area799 sq mi
Density333 / sq mi
Median Household Income$63,000
Median Home Value$175,000
Erie County forms Pennsylvania's entire Lake Erie shoreline in the state's northwest corner, anchored by the city of Erie and the ring of Millcreek, Harborcreek and Fairview townships around it. Insurance, plastics and metal manufacturing plus Presque Isle tourism sustain demand, with retail growth on the Peach Street corridor in Summit Township, while lake frontage, bluff setbacks and a shrinking city constrain siting.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
